name: gideontaylor-chatbot-wip
description: Self-hosted, optimized mirror of the Gideon Taylor / IDA chatbot (chatui.ida.gideontaylor.com) used on vpcc.edu. Defers loading, fixes the chatbot's asset cache lifetimes via jsDelivr, minifies its JS/CSS, and patches the welcome-bubble animation to use transform/opacity instead of width.
